<!--
STYLE (especially for AI authors):
- Be terse. A few plain sentences beat a wall of text. If it fits in one, use one.
- Plain prose. Avoid bold, emoji, tables, headers beyond the sections below, and nested structure.
- Use bullets only for genuinely separate items, never to pad a single thought.
- Bullets are short sentences. One point per bullet, no run-ons, no sub-bullets.
- Link code/PRs/issues instead of pasting; quote only the few lines that matter.
- State the fact, not the journey. Don't narrate the investigation or restate the title.
- Write what is true now; don't use "now/no longer/previously".
-->

<!-- TITLE: short and plain, no prefix. Don't encode the type in the title.
     Set a built-in label instead (bug, enhancement, etc.). -->

## What

<!--
The problem, request, or task in a sentence or two.
- For a bug: what's wrong and where (the symptom + the file/component), not a repro narrative.
- For a task/request: the concrete change you want, stated as an outcome.
- Include the one detail that pins it down (a file:line, a flag, an input that triggers it). Skip the rest.
-->

## Why

<!--
Optional. Explain why this matters, or what breaks if it's ignored.
Drop this section entirely if it's obvious from What. Don't restate What in other words.
-->
